mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.member_id, b.title, b.content, m.name AS author_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM board b INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = b.member_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT b.id, b.member_id, b.title, b.content, m.name AS author_name, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM board b INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = b.member_id WHERE b.id = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
